title: La taglia è tua... l'uomo l'ammazzo io
writer: Fabrizio Gianni, Ignacio F. Iquino, Edoardo Mulargia
actors: Robert Woods, Aldo Berti, Marc Fiorini
plot: An alcoholic outlaw is sheltered from a gang of greedy bounty hunters by a sympathetic saloon girl, whom he soon set out to avenge when they kill her.
